user.title: Home Climate Control
user.description: Choose how to connect the boiler. Use **Demo OTGW** to test the app without hardware.

demo.title: Demo OTGW
demo.description: Creates a simulated OpenTherm gateway with outdoor temperature, boiler flame/modulation, and two rooms (Living Room + Bedroom). No MQTT or hardware required. Open the **Home Climate** sidebar after setup.

otgw.title: OTGW via MQTT
otgw.description: Connect to your OpenTherm Gateway (OTGW-firmware MQTT). Outdoor temperature is read from the boiler outdoor sensor.

zone.title: Add a heating zone
zone.description: Zones already added: {zone_count}. Each zone needs a room temperature sensor. Optional TRVs are respected as demand sources; optional window sensors pause the zone when open.

data.name: Zone name
data.add_another: Add another zone after this one
